title: Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
   C. Say Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat.
   C. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Islamic Morality? (1 mark)
   A. Say Significance of Islamic Morality has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Islamic Morality.
   C. Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Significance of Islamic Morality to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in the Last Day Hellfire to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in the Last Day Hellfire.
   C. Say Belief in the Last Day Hellfire has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Virtues in Islam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Virtues in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prohibitions in Islam Zina? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prohibitions in Islam Zina.
   C. Say Prohibitions in Islam Zina has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prohibitions in Islam Zina to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Tawbah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Significance of Islamic Morality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam Zina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Tawbah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Qur’an miraculous nature of the Qur’an the Qur’an Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Significance of Islamic Morality with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Belief in the Last Day Hellfire with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

11. A — Apply the teaching of Prohibitions in Islam Zina with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Ulum al-Hadith Hadith compilation of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Tawbah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Significance of Islamic Morality; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam Zina; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
